title: peristylus cryptostylus
intro: Peristylus cryptostylus, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Peristylus cryptostylus include relieving fever, reducing pain and inflammation, and treating digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
